#pragma warning disable MAAI001 // Genuine pinned native approval composition with real PostgreSQL publication barriers.
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Encodings.Web;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using Hashbrown.Conformance.Integration;
using Hashbrown.Conformance.Testing;
using Microsoft.Agents.AI;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;
using Microsoft.Extensions.AI;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Npgsql;

static void Check(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new Exception(message); }
await using var source = NpgsqlDataSource.Create(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DOTNET_TEST_POSTGRES") ?? throw new Exception("Real PostgreSQL required."));
var schema = "approval_publication_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
var effects = 0;
var function = AIFunctionFactory.Create((string code) => { effects++; return code; }, "backend");
var protectedFunction = new ApprovalRequiredAIFunction(function);
var catalog = new NativeToolCatalog([new("backend", 1, function.JsonSchema, RequiresConfirmation: true)]);
var durable = new PostgresNativeSessionJournal(source, catalog, "publication-v1", schema);
try
{
    await durable.InitializeAsync();
    foreach (var stage in new[] { "before-pending-save", "after-save-before-publication", "publication-authorized", "before-publication-finalization", "cancel-before-pending-save" })
    {
        var selected = stage == "cancel-before-pending-save" ? "before-pending-save" : stage;
        var gate = new FixtureNativeGate(selected);
        var journal = new FixtureNativeJournal(durable, gate);
        var model = new PendingModel();
        await using var app = await Start(journal, model);
        using var http = new HttpClient { BaseAddress = new Uri(app.Urls.Single()), Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15) };
        using var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(12));
        var input = new JsonObject { ["threadId"] = stage, ["runId"] = "initial", ["messages"] = new JsonArray(new JsonObject { ["id"] = "u1", ["role"] = "user", ["content"] = "protect" }), ["tools"] = new JsonArray(), ["context"] = new JsonArray(), ["state"] = new JsonObject() };
        var key = new NativeSessionKey("native", "gate-owned", stage, new Dictionary<string, string> { ["isolation"] = "gate-owned" });
        var wire = new Wire();
        var request = Read(http, input, wire, cancellation.Token);
        await Wait(() => gate.Stage == selected || request.IsCompleted);
        Check(gate.Stage == selected, "Actual genuine native approval request must reach its selected publication gate: " + stage + ": " + wire.Text);
        var status = (await durable.InspectAsync(new HashSet<string> { "gate-owned" }, key))!.Status;
        var readOnly = await durable.ReadStatusAsync(key);

        Check(effects == 0 && model.Calls == 1 && readOnly.PublicRequest is null && readOnly.PendingInterrupts is null, "Pending native gates cannot dispatch, continue the model or expose an apparently published recovery snapshot.");
        if (stage == "before-publication-finalization")
        {
            await Wait(() => wire.Terminal);
            Check(status.State == "Publishing" && (await durable.TryAcquireAsync(key, input.ToJsonString())).Status == 409, "A publisher holding finalization prevents competing native acquisition.");
            // Stale-callback CAS proof: this fixture pauses after genuine write/flush, not a cross-process quiescence claim.
            Check(await durable.RetireAsync(new HashSet<string> { "gate-owned" }, key, "operator", new(status.State!, status.Generation, status.Revision, "Retired", "fixture genuine terminal write/flush complete; finalization callback suspended", "stale-finalization-cas-fixture", true)) == 200, "Current operator CAS must retire the publishing selector.");
            gate.Release(); await request;
            Check((await durable.InspectAsync(new HashSet<string> { "gate-owned" }, key))!.Status.State == "Retired", "A stale finalization callback cannot overwrite the operator CAS.");
        }
        else if (stage == "publication-authorized")
        {
            Check(!wire.Terminal && status.State == "Publishing" && (await durable.TryAcquireAsync(key, input.ToJsonString())).Status == 409, "Publishing reserves the still-held genuine interrupt and rejects competitors.");
            gate.Release(); await request;
            var ready = (await durable.InspectAsync(new HashSet<string> { "gate-owned" }, key))!.Status;
            await using var published = source.CreateCommand($"SELECT published_revision FROM \"{schema}\".native_approval_batches WHERE session_id=@id"); published.Parameters.AddWithValue("id", key.Id);
            Check(wire.Terminal && ready.State == "Ready" && (long)(await published.ExecuteScalarAsync())! + 2 == ready.Revision, "The genuine interrupt publishes only through its actual Save receipt, authorization and finalization revision sequence.");
        }
        else if (stage == "cancel-before-pending-save")
        {
            Check(!wire.Terminal, "A captured unpublished native interrupt remains non-actionable before Save.");
            cancellation.Cancel(); await request;
            await WaitAsync(async () => (await durable.InspectAsync(new HashSet<string> { "gate-owned" }, key))!.Status.State == "Blocked");
            Check(!wire.Terminal && (await durable.TryAcquireAsync(key, input.ToJsonString())).Lease is null, "Actual capture-before-Save cancellation keeps identities fenced and blocks replacement work.");
        }
        else
        {
            Check(!wire.Terminal && status.State == (stage == "before-pending-save" ? "Owned" : "Saved"), "No actionable genuine interrupt may precede Save plus authorization: " + stage);
            Check(await durable.RetireAsync(new HashSet<string> { "gate-owned" }, key, "operator", new(status.State!, status.Generation, status.Revision, "Retired", "fixture publisher suspended before authorized terminal write", "pre-publication-native-gate", true)) == 200, "Scoped exact operator CAS must invalidate the old owner or receipt before authorization.");
            gate.Release(); await request;
            Check(!wire.Terminal && (await durable.InspectAsync(new HashSet<string> { "gate-owned" }, key))!.Status.State == "Retired" && (await durable.TryAcquireAsync(key, input.ToJsonString())).Status == 410, "Retired initial captures and saved receipts must withhold stale actionable interrupt bytes.");
        }
        await using var retained = source.CreateCommand($"SELECT count(*) FROM \"{schema}\".native_approvals WHERE session_id=@id"); retained.Parameters.AddWithValue("id", key.Id);
        Check((long)(await retained.ExecuteScalarAsync())! == 2 && effects == 0, "Every publication outcome retains permanent genuine member identities with zero protected effects.");
    }
    foreach (var mutation in new[] { "missing-approvals", "missing-member", "request-id", "call-version", "call-name", "call-arguments", "native-location", "member-order", "public-position", "public-parent", "public-arguments", "missing-pending", "extra-browser", "completed-pending", "aggregate-overflow", "aggregate-exact", "repeat-save" })
    {
        var originalUnchanged = false; var attempted = false; var actualBudget = 0L;
        var journal = new SaveJournal(durable, async (lease, save, ct) =>
        {
            attempted = true;
            var before = JsonSerializer.Serialize(save, JsonSerializerOptions.Web);
            var candidate = Changed(save, mutation);
            INativeSessionJournal target = durable;
            if (mutation.StartsWith("aggregate-", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                await using var table = source.CreateCommand($"SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(sum(octet_length(private_descriptor)),0) FROM \"{schema}\".native_approvals WHERE session_id=@id)+(SELECT COALESCE(sum(octet_length(descriptor)),0) FROM \"{schema}\".native_invocations WHERE session_id=@id)"); table.Parameters.AddWithValue("id", lease.Key.Id);
                var storedBytes = Convert.ToInt64((await table.ExecuteScalarAsync(ct))!);
                var payloadBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(JsonSerializer.Serialize(save.Approvals, JsonSerializerOptions.Web)) + save.PendingCalls.Sum(call => Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(JsonSerializer.Serialize(call, JsonSerializerOptions.Web)));
                actualBudget = checked((long)storedBytes + payloadBytes);
                var limit = checked((int)actualBudget - (mutation == "aggregate-overflow" ? 1 : 0));
                Check(Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(save.NativeJson) < limit && payloadBytes < limit, "Aggregate regression must exercise combined descriptor copies, not the separate opaque-native or single-payload limit.");
                target = new PostgresNativeSessionJournal(source, catalog, "publication-v1", schema, new NativeSessionOptions { NativeBytes = limit });
            }

            var receipt = await target.SaveAsync(lease, candidate, ct);

            originalUnchanged = before == JsonSerializer.Serialize(save, JsonSerializerOptions.Web);
            if (mutation == "repeat-save")
            {
                Check(receipt is not null && await durable.SaveAsync(lease, candidate, ct) is null, "An initial pending batch may receive one actual save receipt only.");
                return receipt;
            }
            if (mutation != "aggregate-exact")
            {
                Check(receipt is null, "A pending save must refuse inconsistent genuine producer/private/public/native binding or aggregate overflow: " + mutation);
                await using var epoch = source.CreateCommand($"SELECT published_revision FROM \"{schema}\".native_approval_batches WHERE session_id=@id"); epoch.Parameters.AddWithValue("id", lease.Key.Id);
                Check(await epoch.ExecuteScalarAsync(ct) is DBNull, "Rejected pending saves must roll back publication epoch together with payload: " + mutation);
            }
            else Check(receipt is not null, "The exact counted aggregate limit must admit an otherwise valid genuine pending producer.");
            return receipt;
        });
        var model = new PendingModel(); await using var app = await Start(journal, model);
        using var http = new HttpClient { BaseAddress = new Uri(app.Urls.Single()), Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15) };
        var input = new JsonObject { ["threadId"] = mutation, ["runId"] = "initial", ["messages"] = new JsonArray(new JsonObject { ["id"] = "u1", ["role"] = "user", ["content"] = "protect" }), ["tools"] = new JsonArray(), ["context"] = new JsonArray(), ["state"] = new JsonObject() };
        var wire = new Wire();

        await Read(http, input, wire, default);

        var key = new NativeSessionKey("native", "gate-owned", mutation, new Dictionary<string, string> { ["isolation"] = "gate-owned" });
        await WaitAsync(async () => (await durable.InspectAsync(new HashSet<string> { "gate-owned" }, key))!.Status.State is "Ready" or "Blocked");
        var status = (await durable.InspectAsync(new HashSet<string> { "gate-owned" }, key))!.Status;
        var accepted = mutation is "aggregate-exact" or "repeat-save";
        Check(attempted && originalUnchanged && wire.Terminal == accepted && status.State == (accepted ? "Ready" : "Blocked") && effects == 0 && model.Calls == 1, "Only a complete coherent genuine pending batch may publish; denied captures stay fenced without mutating original save inputs: " + mutation + $" attempted={attempted}; unchanged={originalUnchanged}; terminal={wire.Terminal}; state={status.State}; models={model.Calls}; effects={effects}");
        if (mutation.StartsWith("aggregate-", StringComparison.Ordinal)) Console.WriteLine($"pending aggregate {mutation}: exact-counted-bytes={actualBudget}; terminal={wire.Terminal}");
    }
    Console.WriteLine("Native approval publication barriers passed.");
}
finally
{
    await using var cleanup = source.CreateCommand($"DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS \"{schema}\" CASCADE"); await cleanup.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
}
async Task<WebApplication> Start(INativeSessionJournal journal, PendingModel model)
{
    var builder = WebApplication.CreateEmptyBuilder(new() { EnvironmentName = "Production", ContentRootPath = AppContext.BaseDirectory });
    builder.WebHost.UseKestrel().UseUrls("http://127.0.0.1:0"); builder.Logging.ClearProviders(); builder.Services.AddRouting();
    builder.Services.AddAuthentication("fixture").AddScheme<AuthenticationSchemeOptions, FixtureAuthentication>("fixture", _ => { });
    builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options => options.AddPolicy("native", policy => policy.RequireAuthenticatedUser()));
    var accessor = new HttpContextAccessor(); builder.Services.AddSingleton<IHttpContextAccessor>(accessor);
    NativeSessionEndpointConfiguration.Configure(builder.Services, "native", journal, catalog, _ => "gate-owned");
    var agent = NativeSessionAgentFactory.Create(model, "native", [protectedFunction], catalog, accessor);
    var app = builder.Build(); app.UseAuthentication(); app.UseAuthorization();
    NativeSessionEndpointConfiguration.Map(app, "/run", agent, "native"); await app.StartAsync(); return app;
}
static NativeSessionSave Changed(NativeSessionSave source, string mutation)
{
    if (mutation is "aggregate-overflow" or "aggregate-exact" or "repeat-save") return source;
    var bound = source.Approvals.PendingBatch!; var batch = bound.Batch;
    var members = batch.ProtectedRequests.ToArray(); var locations = bound.PublicLocations.ToDictionary(pair => pair.Key, pair => pair.Value, StringComparer.Ordinal);
    var pending = source.PendingCalls.ToArray(); var browserIds = source.ExpectedBrowserCallIds.ToArray(); var publicRequest = source.PublicRequest;
    var first = members[0]; var call = first.Call;
    if (mutation == "missing-member") { members = members.Take(1).ToArray(); locations.Remove(batch.ProtectedRequests[1].RequestId); }
    if (mutation == "request-id") { members[0] = new("foreign", call, first.NativeLocation); locations.Remove(first.RequestId); locations.Add("foreign", bound.PublicLocations[first.RequestId]); }
    if (mutation == "call-version") members[0] = new(first.RequestId, new(call.Id, call.Name, call.Version + 1, call.Arguments), first.NativeLocation);
    if (mutation == "call-name") members[0] = new(first.RequestId, new(call.Id, "foreign", call.Version, call.Arguments), first.NativeLocation);
    if (mutation == "call-arguments") members[0] = new(first.RequestId, new(call.Id, call.Name, call.Version, JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new { code = "foreign" })), first.NativeLocation);
    if (mutation == "native-location") members[0] = new(first.RequestId, call, new(first.NativeLocation.MessageId, first.NativeLocation.MessageIndex, first.NativeLocation.ContentIndex + 1));
    if (mutation == "member-order") members = members.Reverse().ToArray();
    if (mutation == "public-position") { locations[first.RequestId] = bound.PublicLocations[members[1].RequestId]; locations[members[1].RequestId] = bound.PublicLocations[first.RequestId]; }
    if (mutation == "public-parent") { var location = locations[first.RequestId]; locations[first.RequestId] = new("foreign", location.MessageIndex, location.CallIndex); }
    if (mutation == "public-arguments")
    {
        var root = JsonNode.Parse(publicRequest)!; var location = locations[first.RequestId];
        root["messages"]![location.MessageIndex]!["toolCalls"]![location.CallIndex]!["function"]!["arguments"] = "{\"code\":\"foreign\"}";
        publicRequest = root.ToJsonString();
    }
    if (mutation == "missing-pending") pending = pending.Take(1).ToArray();
    if (mutation == "extra-browser") browserIds = ["foreign"];
    var approvals = mutation == "missing-approvals" ? NativeApprovalSnapshot.Empty : new NativeApprovalSnapshot(new NativeBoundApprovalBatch(new NativeApprovalBatch(batch.BatchId, members, batch.BrowserBindings), locations));
    return new(source.NativeJson, publicRequest, pending, browserIds, mutation == "completed-pending", approvals);
}

static async Task Read(HttpClient http, JsonObject input, Wire wire, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
{
    try
    {
        using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "/run") { Content = JsonContent.Create(input) };
        using var response = await http.SendAsync(request, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead, cancellationToken);
        using var stream = await response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(cancellationToken); var bytes = new byte[4096];
        while (true) { var read = await stream.ReadAsync(bytes, cancellationToken); if (read == 0) break; wire.Append(Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes, 0, read)); }
    }
    catch (Exception exception) when (exception is HttpRequestException or IOException or OperationCanceledException) { }
}
static async Task Wait(Func<bool> condition) => await WaitAsync(() => Task.FromResult(condition()));
static async Task WaitAsync(Func<Task<bool>> condition)
{
    using var budget = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
    while (!await condition()) await Task.Delay(10, budget.Token);
}
sealed class Wire
{
    private readonly object _gate = new(); private readonly StringBuilder _text = new();
    public string Text { get { lock (_gate) return _text.ToString(); } }
    public bool Terminal => Text.Contains("\"type\":\"RUN_FINISHED\"", StringComparison.Ordinal);
    public void Append(string value) { lock (_gate) _text.Append(value); }
}
sealed class PendingModel : IChatClient
{
    public int Calls { get; private set; }
    public Task<ChatResponse> GetResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        Calls++;
        if (Calls != 1) throw new Exception("Pending native approval cannot continue the model.");
        return Task.FromResult(new ChatResponse(new ChatMessage(ChatRole.Assistant, [new FunctionCallContent("back_1", "backend", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["code"] = "one" }), new FunctionCallContent("back_2", "backend", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["code"] = "two" })]) { MessageId = "native-parent" }) { ResponseId = "native-parent", FinishReason = ChatFinishReason.ToolCalls });
    }
    public async IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate> GetStreamingResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    { foreach (var update in (await GetResponseAsync(messages, options, cancellationToken)).ToChatResponseUpdates()) yield return update; }
    public object? GetService(Type serviceType, object? serviceKey = null) => null;
    public void Dispose() { }
}
sealed class FixtureAuthentication(IOptionsMonitor<AuthenticationSchemeOptions> options, ILoggerFactory logger, UrlEncoder encoder) : AuthenticationHandler<AuthenticationSchemeOptions>(options, logger, encoder)
{
    protected override Task<AuthenticateResult> HandleAuthenticateAsync() => Task.FromResult(AuthenticateResult.Success(new AuthenticationTicket(new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity([new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, "gate-owned")], "fixture")), "fixture")));
}

sealed class SaveJournal(INativeSessionJournal inner, Func<NativeSessionLease, NativeSessionSave, CancellationToken, ValueTask<NativeSavedReceipt?>> save) : INativeSessionJournal
{
    public ValueTask InitializeAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.InitializeAsync(ct);
    public ValueTask<NativeSessionAdmission> TryAcquireAsync(NativeSessionKey key, string input, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.TryAcquireAsync(key, input, ct);
    public ValueTask<bool> CaptureModelCallAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, NativeToolCall call, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.CaptureModelCallAsync(lease, call, ct);
    public ValueTask<bool> CaptureApprovalBatchAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, NativeApprovalBatch batch, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.CaptureApprovalBatchAsync(lease, batch, ct);
    public ValueTask<NativeApprovalEvidence?> GetOwnedApprovalEvidenceAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.GetOwnedApprovalEvidenceAsync(lease, ct);
    public ValueTask<bool> TryAdmitApprovalBatchAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, string batch, NativeApprovalAdmissionEnvelope admission, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.TryAdmitApprovalBatchAsync(lease, batch, admission, ct);
    public ValueTask<bool> SettleApprovalRejectionAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, NativeApprovalRejection rejection, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.SettleApprovalRejectionAsync(lease, rejection, ct);
    public ValueTask<bool> SettleBrowserBypassResultAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, string batch, string request, string call, JsonElement result, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.SettleBrowserBypassResultAsync(lease, batch, request, call, result, ct);
    public ValueTask<NativeToolCall?> GetOwnedCallAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, string call, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.GetOwnedCallAsync(lease, call, ct);
    public ValueTask<bool> TryStartDispatchAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, NativeToolCall call, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.TryStartDispatchAsync(lease, call, ct);
    public ValueTask<bool> CompleteDispatchAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, NativeToolCall call, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.CompleteDispatchAsync(lease, call, ct);
    public ValueTask<bool> RenewAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.RenewAsync(lease, ct);
    public ValueTask<NativeSavedReceipt?> SaveAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, NativeSessionSave value, CancellationToken ct = default) => save(lease, value, ct);
    public ValueTask<bool> AuthorizePublicationAsync(NativeSavedReceipt receipt, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.AuthorizePublicationAsync(receipt, ct);
    public ValueTask<bool> FinalizePublicationAsync(NativeSavedReceipt receipt, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.FinalizePublicationAsync(receipt, ct);
    public ValueTask<bool> FailureCleanupAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.FailureCleanupAsync(lease, ct);
    public ValueTask<NativeSessionStatus> ReadStatusAsync(NativeSessionKey key, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ReadStatusAsync(key, ct);
    public ValueTask<NativeSessionInspection?> InspectAsync(IReadOnlySet<string> scopes, NativeSessionKey key, int limit = 50, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.InspectAsync(scopes, key, limit, ct);
    public ValueTask<int> ReconcileAsync(IReadOnlySet<string> scopes, NativeSessionKey key, string actor, NativeSessionReconciliation request, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ReconcileAsync(scopes, key, actor, request, ct);
    public ValueTask<int> RetireAsync(IReadOnlySet<string> scopes, NativeSessionKey key, string actor, NativeSessionReconciliation request, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.RetireAsync(scopes, key, actor, request, ct);
    public ValueTask<int> MaintainAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.MaintainAsync(ct);
}
